headline: Brief v2.1.0-beta — Authentic Claude #d9693f Animations & Official Brief Code Mascot, New Brief^Ai White-on-Black Logo & Live Touch Screen Typing
bullets: Authentic Claude 4-State #d9693f Animations & Official Brief Code Logo: Exact 8-frame hand-drawn Claude starburst for Starting/Checking, untouched 200x200 3D Orbiting Dots for Thinking, crisp solid bouncing & pulsing circles for Creating/Finding files, and Anthropic's official Claude Code pixel mascot on Brief Code.
New White-on-Black brief^Ai Brand Logo Everywhere: Crisp white brief^Ai lettering on pure black fitted cleanly across Windows, Linux, Android phones & tablets, website navbar, and GitHub.

Live Touch Screen Typing (Recommended) vs. Keyboard Method: Highlights what Brief clicks on screen and types visibly letter-by-letter on Android tablets & phones, with a 1-tap option to switch to direct Windows-style keyboard input.

Gemini 4 Carbon, 3.8 Flash Fix & Universal </> Live Code Card: Fast reliable Gemini 3.8 Flash & 4 Carbon routing, centered Extra High thinking, 48 dynamic Claude greetings, OpenAI GPT-6 Work suite, and live </> code execution cards.
